about: Completed games that the College Football Data API does not have, entered by hand from cited contemporary sources. Merged into the game stream by supplemental_games.py wherever the belt is walked (build_lineage.py, build_alternate_lineages.py) and applied to the committed baseline by apply_supplemental_games.py. Ids live in the reserved 90,000,000-99,999,999 range so they can never collide with a CFBD id. See ruleset.md, 'Games missing from the data source'.

games.reason: Missing from CFBD. Ends Olympic Club's 1931 reign two weeks after it began (CFBD's record has it running to Stanford, 1932-09-17). Reported by Ray of rutgersstartedthis.com.
games.note: Olympic Club split its roster that week: half sailed for Hawaii and half stayed to play this previously scheduled game. It was an official Olympic Club game, so it counts.
